name: ai.unitedcompute/gpu-prices
title: GPU Cloud Prices
description: Live rental prices and real availability for 70+ GPUs (H100, B200, RTX 5090) across 50+ clouds.

tools.name: search_gpu_offers
tools.description: Find single cloud GPUs (on demand) you can rent right now, cheapest first, across all tracked clouds. Returns price per GPU-hour in USD, cloud, stock level, regions and a link to rent.

gpu.description: GPU id or name fragment, e.g. 'H100', 'B200', 'RTX 4090', 'h100-sxm-80gb'. Comma-separated for several.

region.description: ISO country code or name (US, DE, Germany), an area (Europe, North America, Asia, Oceania, South America, Africa), a data center id, or a city

cloud_type.description: datacenter = provider's own data centers; community = marketplace hosts (cheaper, less reliable)

pricing.description: Default on_demand. spot is cheaper but the provider can stop it at any time.

exclude_resellers.description: Drop resellers and offers read through a reseller

include_unavailable.description: Also return offers that cannot be rented right now (default false)

tools.name: list_gpus
tools.description: All tracked GPU models with VRAM, the cheapest price you can rent each at right now (data center and community) and how many clouds have it in stock.

gpu.description: GPU id or name fragment, e.g. 'H100', 'B200', 'RTX 4090', 'h100-sxm-80gb'. Comma-separated for several.

in_stock_only.description: Only GPUs rentable somewhere right now (default true)

tools.name: get_gpu
tools.description: Specs and every offer (all clouds, in stock or not) for one GPU model.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Every GPU cloud in the index, with its website, whether it is a marketplace or reseller, and how many offers it has in stock.
